description.zh:
◆ 非在野状态时，获得策略【苛捐杂税（大）】

◆ 所属城市金钱收入增加10%

◆ 自身谋害能力提高15%
description.en:
◆ When not Free, gains Strategy 【Heavy Taxation (L)】



◆ +10% Home City Funds Income



◆ +15% own Assassination Ability

description.zh: 直接将700策略点兑现为15000金,  存入君主所在城市。
description.en: Directly convert 700 Strategy Points into 15,000 Gold, deposited in the Ruler's city.

description2.zh: 特殊攻击牌，造成1.2倍杀伤，随机偷对方一张牌。
description2.en: Special Attack Card. Deals 1.2x damage and randomly steals 1 card from the opponent.

description2.zh: 目标每回合初损失等同于发动者攻击力一半的伤害，持续3回合。
description2.en: Target takes damage equal to half the user's Attack at the start of each turn for 3 turns.

description2.zh: 每次出牌有50%概率获得一张【嘲讽之策】，每回合第一次使用【嘲讽之策】时获得一点行动AP并恢复自身400点MP。
description2.en: 50% chance to gain a 【Taunt Stratagem】 card whenever a card is played. The first time 【Taunt Stratagem】 is used each turn, gain 1 AP and restore 400 MP.

description2.zh: 每次攻击命中对敌人添加一层【言毒】状态，最高叠加3层，每层言毒在回合开始时损失当前形势值的2%，持续3回合。
description2.en: Each attack hit applies 1 stack of 【Venomous Words】 to the enemy (max 3 stacks). Each stack causes the target to lose 2% of current Momentum at the start of the turn, lasting 3 turns.

description.zh: 洁白的羽扇，用来提醒自己最合适不过。
description.en: A pristine white feather fan, perfect for reminding oneself to stay composed.

description.zh: 采用了稍微好一些的面料并进行了纹饰处理的长袍，衣服的边缘处也添加了简单的纹饰。
description.en: A long robe made of slightly finer fabric adorned with patterns, with simple trim along the edges as well.

description.zh: 带有金色小匾装饰的五梁冠，该装饰象征了佩戴者的地位。
description.en: A five-ridge crown with a gold plaque decoration, symbolizing the wearer's rank.

desc.zh: 普天之下莫非王土，率土之滨莫非王臣。出自姬姓，汉景帝之子河间献王刘德之后。刘德为汉景帝第三子，封河间王，谥“献”，以收集整理先秦古籍闻名。东汉时，河间王系延续，至刘开（河间孝王）时，其子刘淑封解渎亭侯，刘淑之子刘苌袭爵。刘苌早逝，其子刘宏袭解渎亭侯。永康元年，汉桓帝崩，无子，窦太后与窦武迎立刘宏为帝，是为汉灵帝。汉灵帝在位二十一年，是东汉在位时间最长的皇帝之一，但其统治时期朝政腐败、宦官专权、黄巾起义爆发，东汉帝国在他手中走向崩溃。其子刘辩（少帝）在位仅数月即被董卓所废杀；刘协（献帝）为东汉末代皇帝，被董卓、曹操先后挟持，最终禅位于曹丕，东汉灭亡。
desc.en: Under the vast heavens, none is not the king's land, along the shores of the realm, none is not the king's subject. Descended from the Ji surname, they trace their lineage to Liu De, Prince Xian of Hejian and son of Emperor Jing of Han. Liu De, the third son of Emperor Jing, was enfeoffed as Prince of Hejian with the posthumous title ‘Xian,’ and was celebrated for gathering and preserving pre-Qin classics. During the Eastern Han, the princely line of Hejian endured, in the time of Liu Kai (Prince Xiao of Hejian), his son Liu Shu was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Jieduting, an honor inherited by Liu Shu's son Liu Chang. Liu Chang died prematurely, whereupon his son Liu Hong inherited the marquisate. In the first year of the Yongkang era, Emperor Huan passed away without an heir, Empress Dowager Dou and Dou Wu elevated Liu Hong to the throne as Emperor Ling of Han. Reigning for twenty-one years, Emperor Ling was one of the longest-ruling emperors of the Eastern Han, yet his reign was rife with court corruption, eunuch dominance, and the outbreak of the Yellow Turban Rebellion, leading the Eastern Han Empire toward collapse in his hands. His son Liu Bian (the Young Emperor) reigned for a mere few months before being deposed and murdered by Dong Zhuo, Liu Xie (Emperor Xian) was the final emperor of the Eastern Han, coerced in succession by Dong Zhuo and Cao Cao before ultimately abdicating the throne to Cao Pi, marking the downfall of the Eastern Han.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

desc.zh:
黄巾之乱时，卢植围攻张角，左丰索贿不成，诬其“惰慢军心”，卢植被罢官下狱。乱平后卢植仍陷囹圄，刘备决意营救恩师。

触发条件：刘备、关羽、张飞、简雍、卢植、皇甫嵩、朱儁、汉灵帝、何进、十常侍、袁绍存活且在正确势力。

禁忌条件：主角为卢植、皇甫嵩、朱儁、何进、十常侍时无法触发

亲历条件：【与刘备关系等级大于等于2】。
desc.en:
During the Yellow Turban Rebellion, Lu Zhi besieged Zhang Jiao. When Zuo Feng failed to extort a bribe from him, he falsely accused Lu Zhi of ‘slackness and undermining army morale,’ leading to Lu Zhi being stripped of his post and imprisoned. Even after the rebellion was quelled, Lu Zhi remained behind bars, and Liu Bei resolved to rescue his former mentor.



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Jian Yong, Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, Emperor Ling of Han, He Jin, the Ten Attendants, and Yuan Shao are alive and in the correct Factions.



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, He Jin, or one of the Ten Attendants



Participation Requirement: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】.

desc.zh:
忍辱行贿？或随翼德挥拳？为刘备得官道贺，却遇贪污行贿之事......

禁忌条件：主角为张让，段珪时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与刘备关系等级大于2级或作为刘备、关羽、张飞】
desc.en:
Endure the humiliation and offer a bribe? Or throw punches alongside Yide? Arriving to congratulate Liu Bei on his appointment, only to encounter corrupt extortion...



Forbidden Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Zhang Rang or Duan Gui.



Participation Requirement: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is greater than Level 2, or play as Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei】

biography.zh: 汉末宦官，臭名昭著的十常侍之首，在汉灵帝的保护下祸乱朝纲、颠倒黑白、倒卖官职。汉灵帝驾崩后，大将军何进欲诛杀十常侍，张让等人利用何太后为其求情，躲过一劫，随后便招何进入宫，将其暗杀。在宫外守候的的袁绍、曹操察觉到异象后拔剑进入宫内，诛杀部分十常侍，张让等逃跑的十常侍便劫刘辩、刘协出逃，袁绍又派兵追杀，张让等人最终投水自尽。
biography.tc: 漢末宦官，臭名昭著的十常侍之首，在漢靈帝的保護下禍亂朝綱、顛倒黑白、倒賣官職。漢靈帝駕崩后，大將軍何進欲誅殺十常侍，張讓等人利用何太后為其求情，躲過一劫，隨后便招何進入宮，將其暗殺。在宮外守候的的袁紹、曹操察覺到異象后拔劍進入宮內，誅殺部分十常侍，張讓等逃跑的十常侍便劫劉辯、劉協出逃，袁紹又派兵追殺，張讓等人最終投水自盡。
biography.en: A eunuch of the late Han and the chief of the infamous Ten Attendants, who threw the court into chaos, reversed right and wrong, and sold official posts under Emperor Ling's protection. After Emperor Ling's death, Grand General He Jin sought to eliminate the Ten Attendants. Zhang Rang and the others used Empress Dowager He to plead for them and escaped harm. They then lured He Jin into the palace and assassinated him. Yuan Shao and Cao Cao, on guard outside the palace, sensed something amiss and charged in with drawn swords, killing some of the Ten Attendants. Zhang Rang and the other fleeing attendants abducted Liu Bian and Liu Xie to escape. Yuan Shao sent soldiers in pursuit, and Zhang Rang and his cohort ultimately drowned themselves in the river.
biography.jp: 後漢末期の宦官で、悪名高い十常侍の筆頭。霊帝の庇護のもとで国政を乱し、是非を曲解して売官をほしいままにした。霊帝の崩御後、大将軍の何進が十常侍の誅殺を図るが、張譲らは何太后を通じて命乞いをして難を逃れ、直後に何進を宮中に誘い出して暗殺した。宮外で待機していた袁紹と曹操が異変を察知して剣を抜いて宮中に突入し、十常侍の一部を誅殺すると、張譲ら生き残った十常侍は劉弁と劉協を拉致して逃走した。袁紹がさらに追兵を放って追撃させると、張譲らは最後は水に身を投げて自害した。
biography.kr: 한말의 환관이자 악명 높은 십상시의 수장이다. 한 영제의 비호 아래 조정의 기강을 어지럽히고, 흑백을 전도하며 매관매직을 일삼았다. 영제가 붕어한 후 대장군 하진이 십상시를 주살하려 하자, 장양 등은 하태후를 통해 구명을 청하여 화를 면했다. 이후 하진을 궁궐로 불러들여 암살하였다. 궁 밖에서 대기하던 원소와 조조가 이상한 낌새를 눈치채고 검을 뽑아 든 채 궁 안으로 쳐들어가 십상시 일부를 주살하자, 달아나던 장양 등은 유변과 유협을 인질로 잡고 도주하였다. 원소가 재차 군사를 보내 추격하자, 장양 등은 결국 투수하여 자결하였다.

raw.name: 让
